description: AutoStream provides automated video editing tools for content creators, powered by AI.

policies.refund_policy: No refunds are provided after 7 days from the date of purchase.
policies.support_policy: 24/7 support is available exclusively on the Pro plan. Basic plan users receive email support only.
policies.free_trial: A 7-day free trial is available for the Pro plan.
policies.cancellation: You can cancel your subscription at any time. Access continues until the end of the billing period.

features_overview.ai_captions: Automatically generate accurate captions for your videos using our AI engine. Available on Pro plan only.
features_overview.auto_editing: Our AI analyzes your raw footage and applies smart cuts, transitions, and color grading automatically.
